svg.title: Graphical abstract: transit predictions agreed to minutes, with one hours-long miss
svg.text: How well did published planet-transit predictions hold up?
ExoClock’s November 2025 forecasts: 2,185 accepted TESS timings from 151 planets
Accepted: 2,185 of 3,103 predicted transits; 151 of 156 planets
Each dot: one planet’s largest accepted miss (logarithmic scale)
Ranges include our timing uncertainty. Widening them gave no clear overall gain.
